sources.name: Street Cleaning Schedule (City of Hoboken), compared only

words.rule: Alternate side parking for street cleaning, all year: no parking on one side of the street during its posted hour each week (on Washington St, every weekday morning).
words.afterpass: A $50 ticket. Towing only where a Tow Away Zone sign is posted. Suspended on City holidays and some storm days.
words.dataNotes: Days and hours come from the alternate side parking schedule in the Hoboken Code (section 190-28), placed on the City's street map, which carries an older copy of the same schedule; where the two differ, the Code is shown. The sign on the block wins.
